These are semantic coverage families, not a deterministic keyword checklist. Do not repeat an accepted quote with the same normalized economic identity and do not infer a fact or absence from silence. The same literal quote may support more than one row only when each row has a materially distinct normalized predicate/object and objective effect; cosmetic relabeling is still a duplicate. Do not turn general background or adjacent technical history into production facts merely because it is economically interesting. Never use snippets, future outcomes, score, or Stage.
